core_meaning.primary_meaning: Babar is a Persian-origin name meaning “Tiger, panther”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Babar corresponds to the Persian form بابر (Persian babr). Its core sense is lion, brave leader. Bābar, from Persian babr ('tiger, panther'), the byname of the founder of the Mughal Empire (1483-1530). The source record classified it as Arabic, which is incorrect.

persian.name: ببر
persian.long_meaning: Babar (ببر) نامی برگرفته از زبان فارسی است و معنای اصلی آن شیر، سردار دلیر است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
